title: The Chemistry Flask Heist
briefing: A concentrated vial of experimental catalyst vanished from the reagent vault. Three chemists had badge access that afternoon, and one of them is guilty.

suspects.name: Elena Rostova
suspects.publicStatement: I was in the cold room organizing dry ice shipments.

suspects.name: Tom Chen
suspects.publicStatement: I was running spectrometer tests in bay 2.

suspects.name: Rachel Adams
suspects.publicStatement: I was inspecting ventilation hoods on floor 3.

clues.title: Cold Room Thermostat Log
clues.description: Sensors show the cold storage door remained sealed shut between 2:00 and 3:00 PM.
clues.insight: Contradicts Elena's statement that she spent the afternoon in the cold room.

clues.title: Continuous Spectrometer Readouts
clues.description: Machine timestamps confirm Tom was continuously entering keystrokes at his terminal.
clues.insight: Confirms Tom remained engaged at the workstation during the theft window.

clues.title: Ventilation Audit Sheet
clues.description: A signed inspection paper showing Rachel on the third floor, though someone borrowed her badge copy.
clues.insight: Explains why Rachel's credential badge was active without her presence.

clues.title: Rubber Gasket Shards
clues.description: Torn fragments of chemical gloves coated in solvent matching Elena's bench kit.
clues.insight: Physically links Elena's bench supplies to the forced vault seal.

clues.title: Competitor Offer Letter
clues.description: A signed consulting agreement promising Elena a bonus if proprietary formulas were delivered.
clues.insight: Reveals the financial arrangement behind obtaining the catalyst.

motive: Elena sought to leverage the unpatented catalyst to secure a lucrative private contract.
method: Used a cloned badge to breach the vault seal while faking an alibi in cold storage.
opportunity: Familiarity with lab sensor dead zones allowed unrecorded movement to the vault.

deduction.conclusion: Cold room sensor logs dismantle Elena's claimed alibi completely.
Glove remnants found at the forced vault seal match Elena's workstation equipment.
The competitor offer letter confirms Elena intended to take the formulation.

timeline.event: Elena avoids the cold room and approaches the reagent vault.
Elena tears open the vault seal using specialized bench pliers.
Elena stows the catalyst flask into her travel bag.

hints.text: Review environmental sensor records to verify who was actually where they claimed.
Look for matching tool marks and glove residues left at the compromised seal.
